messages.content: Analyse this resume: Skills: Python, SQL, HTML, CSS. Education: BCA. Experience: Fresher. Job description: Python developer requiring Python, Django, REST API and SQL.

Candidate profile: Entry-level developer with a BCA qualification. Skills: Python, SQL, HTML and CSS. Matching skills: Python and SQL. Missing skills: Django and REST API. Recommendation: Learn Django and REST API development and build a backend project.

Analyse this resume: Skills: Java, C++, MySQL. Education: B.Tech Computer Science. Experience: 1 year Java development. Job description: Java developer requiring Java, Spring Boot, MySQL and REST APIs.

Candidate profile: Java developer with one year of experience and a B.Tech in Computer Science. Matching skills: Java and MySQL. Missing skills: Spring Boot and REST APIs. Recommendation: Develop practical experience with Spring Boot and REST API development.

Analyse this resume: Skills: Excel, Power BI, SQL, Python. Education: B.Sc Mathematics. Experience: 2 years as a data analyst. Job description: Data analyst requiring SQL, Python, Power BI and statistics.

Candidate profile: Data analyst with two years of experience and a B.Sc in Mathematics. Matching skills: Excel, Power BI, SQL and Python. Missing skills: No listed required skills are missing based on the supplied information. Recommendation: Highlight measurable achievements and practical data analysis projects.
